checkpoint_review: The Router's verdicts are accurate and rigorous. The object fundamentally fails the 'Geometry_and_Silhouette' checkpoints: it is not a rectangular slab, the screen does not occupy most of the face, and there is no keyboard/navigation pad. The Router correctly marked these as 'is_present: false'. The 'Functional_Components' checkpoint regarding the OS interface was also correctly marked false as the screen is blank/reflective. The Router appropriately marked ports, stylus, weight, and pocketability as 'is_testable: false' due to resolution limits or visual impossibility. I agree with all assessments; the Router was not lenient.
artifact_review: The Router identified critical structural artifacts. The 'structural_collapse' (severity 4) on the right side is the most significant defect, where a handle-like structure melts into the body without logical mechanical joints. The 'text_gibberish' (severity 3) is confirmed by the image_text_auditor returning empty results despite visible text-like shapes. The 'fusion' (severity 2) at the screen bezel is supported by the topology_boundary_auditor's high confidence mask which likely smoothed over the poor boundary definition. The 'blur' (severity 2) is corroborated by the perceptual_quality_auditor noting compression/pixelation. I agree with the severities; the structural collapse is severe enough to dominate the artifact score.
alignment_reasoning: The image fails almost all defining characteristics of the target class 'hand-held computer'. The fine_grained_classifier ranked 'espresso maker' higher than the target class, indicating a severe semantic mismatch. Only the general material (black plastic) aligns. The form factor is completely wrong (irregular shape vs. rectangular slab), and key functional components (keyboard, UI) are missing. This is a near-total alignment failure.
artifact_reasoning: The image suffers from catastrophic structural incoherence. The right-side 'handle' is a nonsensical fusion of geometry (severity 4). Text elements are illegible gibberish (severity 3). Boundaries are soft and fused (severity 2). While the perceptual auditor only noted moderate compression, the structural defects are far more severe and indicative of generative failure rather than just low resolution.
